audience: online sellers in Poland who manage shop and marketplace orders in Sellasist

useCases.title: Find orders that need attention
useCases.text: The AI lists recent orders by status, payment or source, such as Allegro or your shop, with the buyer, total and comment of each.

useCases.title: Check an order before shipping
useCases.text: The AI opens one order with its items, delivery address, payments and notes, and lists its waybills with tracking numbers.

useCases.title: Spot low stock and bestsellers
useCases.text: The AI lists products with stock and reserved quantities, checks one product's stock by EAN or symbol, and ranks last month's bestsellers.

useCases.title: Change an order's status and add a note
useCases.text: The AI finds the status id, changes the order's status and adds a note for your staff. Status automations may run; the marketplace is updated only if you ask.

useCases.title: Review returns and refunds
useCases.text: The AI lists return documents by date, order or status and opens one with its refund, courier, tracking and returned items.

useCases.title: Look up invoices
useCases.text: The AI lists invoices by order, series or issue date and opens one with its lines, VAT, total and paid amount.
